description: R10-ANIM1 no-regression arm on the standing suite: the SAME compiled bundle measured with __animationScope:false (historical document-wide animation veto) against __animationScope:true (per-consumer scope). The standing suite has no live animation, so this candidate is EXPECTED TO BE EQUIVALENT, and its whole purpose is to prove the lane is a true no-op when nothing is animated — including that adding the scope lookup costs nothing on the hot path. The opportunity itself is measured by lane6-scratch/r10/probe-r10-anim-scope.mjs, whose fixtures actually place a live animation; this candidate cannot see it by construction.
